name: @proworks-hub/debtiq
description: DebtIQ — debt instruments on exact decimals: seven day-count conventions with the additivity property, EIR solved by deterministic bisection with refusals for every failure mode, unrounded-carry amortized cost, level-payment schedules with a required plug policy, the IFRS 9 10% test with lender-only fees enforced in the type, and covenants as attested per-agreement definitions over a total expression AST.
author: Steven Kreutzer
